$comment: Cost/token PROJECTION for the PyJWT pilot. Superseded historical Anthropic projections are preserved alongside the active zero-cost Google Gemini Developer API Free Tier projection. NOTHING here is an observed billed cost, an observed token count, or an observed latency -- those require an actual API call (see protocol.md §12). Consumed by console/panels/costUsage.js and console/panels/llmAttempts.js.

measured_inputs.evidence_packet_source: experiments/pilot_evidence_packet.md, the literal packet content between its two horizontal rules
measured_inputs.note: These character/word counts are real measurements of real files, not projections. Everything below this key is a projection built on top of them.

token_estimation_method.description: Token estimations based on character and word heuristics (~4 chars/token or 1.33 words/token). Point estimate uses their midpoint.

output_token_assumption.basis: Bounded JSON rule bundle covering two operations (~150-400 tokens).

repair_feedback_assumption.basis: Diagnostics for 1-2 failed sites during repair sweep (~250 tokens).

cost_projection_usd.pricing_tier: Google Gemini Developer API Free Tier
cost_projection_usd.interpretation: Under the zero-monetary-cost project constraint, the Google Gemini Developer API Free Tier is used exclusively. Effective required monetary spend is strictly $0.00.

superseded_historical_anthropic_projecti.status: superseded historical planning estimate, not active
superseded_historical_anthropic_projecti.superseded_reason: Zero-monetary-cost constraint adopted prior to observing any pilot generation.

not_estimated_at_all.latency_per_request: No basis exists without an observed request; recorded as unknown, not zero.
not_estimated_at_all.retry_rate: pilot_config.json sets a retry ceiling (cap chosen by policy), not an observed rate.
not_estimated_at_all.schema_validity_rate: Cannot be projected from pricing or packet size; this is the outcome the real pilot exists to measure.
